pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Medium-scale polygonal regions with soft edge gradients and rounded vertices. Geometries are primarily quadrilaterals and pentagons with light tan coloration and low internal textural contrast.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous light-colored negative space forming a interconnected grid. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-radial (Y-junctions) with thick, consistent pathways between patches on the flank and neck.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the upper neck transition. The mane is short and exhibits a dense, brush-like pixel texture against the out-of-focus background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of four Red-billed Oxpeckers (Buphagus erythrorhynchus) perched on the dorsal ridge and lateral flank, causing localized occlusion of the underlying pelage pattern.
